f.title: Furnish quarterly reports of trial results to the CSC
f.statement: A quarterly report of results obtained during clinical trials shall be furnished to the Clinical Studies Committee (CSC).
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (3)

rows.quote: (3) Quarterly report of results obtained during clinical trials shall be furnished to the CSC.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (3)
rows.review_note: Review: kept because progress reports must carry safety information (rule 8(8)). Actor not named; sponsor/investigator inferred. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Report any adverse reaction immediately to DRAP
f.statement: Any adverse reaction shall be reported immediately to the concerned section of the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan (DRAP).
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (5)

rows.quote: (5) Any adverse reaction shall be reported immediately to the concerned section of the DRAP.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (5)
rows.review_note: Review: actor not named in the rule; sponsor/investigator inferred. Double-check: confirmed; no fixed time, no deadline_rule.

f.title: Permit DRAP officers to copy and verify trial records and reports
f.statement: Sponsors and investigators shall bind themselves to permit nominated DRAP officers, at reasonable times, to copy and verify any records and reports relating to the clinical investigation.
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (7)
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Data integrity & records

rows.quote: (7) The sponsors and the investigators shall make themselves bound to permit access of any nominated officers of the DRAP, at reasonable times to copy and verify any records and reports relating to the clinical investigation.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (7)

f.title: Include sufficient safety information in progress reports
f.statement: The progress report of a clinical trial or study should contain sufficient information to assess the safety of subjects of the clinical investigation.
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (8)

rows.quote: (8) The progress report of clinical trial or studies should contain sufficient information required to access the safety to subjects of the clinical investigations.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (8)
rows.review_note: Review: "access" in source read as "assess". Double-check: should = Recommended.

f.title: Communicate information affecting the benefit-risk assessment immediately to the CSC
f.statement: Any information related to the trial or study that has an important bearing on the benefit-risk assessment of the investigational product, or that would be sufficient to consider changes to the overall conduct of the clinical trial, must be communicated immediately to the CSC.
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (17)

rows.quote:
(17) Any information related to the trial or study that has an important bearing on the benefit-
risk assessment of the investigational product or that would be sufficient to consider changes to the overall conduct of the clinical trial, requires to be communicated immediately with CSC.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (17)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: "requires to be" = Mandatory.

f.title: Investigators maintain and submit a database of enrolled subjects
f.statement: Investigators shall maintain a database of subjects recruited or enrolled for the study or trial (name, father's name, age, gender, CNIC number, address and previous trial or study participation history) and submit it in soft and hard form to DRAP.
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (18)

rows.quote: (18) The investigators shall maintain the database of subjects recruited or enrolled for the study or trial, comprising of information including name, father name, age, gender, CNIC number, address and previous trial or study participation history and shall submit the same in soft and hard form to the DRAP.
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (18)
rows.review_note: Review: kept as safety-related record keeping (stops duplicate enrolment, see rule 21). Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Promptly investigate and inform the CSC of serious or unexpected adverse experiences
f.statement: The CSC may terminate a clinical trial or BA/BE study approval if the sponsor and investigators fail to promptly investigate and inform the CSC of serious or unexpected adverse experiences in accordance with Pakistan GCP or ICH GCP guidelines, or fail to make any other report required, or fail to submit an accurate progress report.
f.clause: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (19)

rows.quote: (a) the sponsor and investigators fail to promptly investigate and inform the CSC for serious or unexpected adverse experiences in accordance with Pakistan GCP or ICH GCP guidelines or fail to make any other report required under this part;
rows.location: Rule 8 Conditions for clinical trials and BA or BE studies, (19)
rows.review_note: Review: sanction clause recorded as the underlying duty with its consequence (termination of approval). Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Develop and implement on-site and centralised monitoring to assure subject safety
f.statement: To assure the safety and protection of human subjects and the quality of the investigation, the sponsor must develop and implement an effective procedure for on-site and centralised monitoring of clinical investigations, in accordance with Pakistan GCP and ICH GCP guidelines.
f.clause: Rule 11 Clinical trials monitoring and oversight activities, (2)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: (2) In order to assure the safety and protection of human subjects and quality of investigation, an effective procedure for on-site and centralized monitoring of clinical investigations must be developed and implemented by the sponsor, in accordance with Pakistan GCP guidelines and ICH-GCP guidelines.
rows.location: Rule 11 Clinical trials monitoring and oversight activities, (2)

f.title: Treat safety assessments and SAE reporting as critical data in the monitoring plan
f.statement: The monitoring plan should prospectively identify critical data and processes; these should ordinarily include conduct and documentation of protocol-required safety assessments, and evaluating, documenting and reporting serious adverse events, unanticipated adverse device effects, subject deaths and withdrawals, especially withdrawals possibly related to an adverse event.
f.clause: Rule 11 Clinical trials monitoring and oversight activities, (4)-(5)(d)
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Quality system & CAPA

rows.quote: (d) conduct and documentation of procedures and assessments related to study endpoints protocol-required safety assessments, evaluating, documenting, and reporting serious adverse events and unanticipated adverse device effects, subject deaths and withdrawals, especially when a withdrawal may be related to an adverse event;
rows.location: Rule 11 Clinical trials monitoring and oversight activities, (4)-(5)(d)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: should = Recommended.

f.title: Promptly review and report all safety information from any source to the CSC
f.statement: The sponsor shall promptly review and report to the CSC all information relevant to the risk-benefit assessment and safety of the investigational product obtained during the investigation or received from any source, foreign or domestic (clinical or epidemiological investigations, animal investigations, commercial marketing experience, scientific literature, unpublished papers, reports from foreign regulatory authorities) not already reported to DRAP.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (1)

rows.quote: (1) The sponsor shall promptly review and report to the CSC, all information relevant to risk-benefit assessment and the safety of the investigational product, obtained during the investigation or otherwise received from any source, foreign or domestic, including information derived from any clinical or epidemiological investigations, animal investigations, commercial marketing experience, reports in the scientific literature, and unpublished scientific papers, as well as reports from foreign regulatory authorities that have not already been previously reported to the DRAP.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (1)

f.title: Submit a written IMP safety report for serious and unexpected adverse experiences within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor or approval holder shall inform DRAP in a written investigational medicinal product safety report of any adverse experience associated with the use of the investigational product that is both serious and unexpected, as soon as possible and not later than fifteen days after the initial receipt of the information.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)(a)

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, not later than 15 days after initial receipt
rows.quote: (2) The sponsor or approval holder shall inform the DRAP in a written investigational medicinal product safety report, for any; (a) adverse experience associated with the use of the investigational product that is both serious and unexpected; or
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)(a)
rows.review_note: Review: deadline sentence sits after item (b) and covers both items. Days not stated as calendar or working; calendar assumed. Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Serious and unexpected adverse experiences with the investigational product

f.title: Report animal findings suggesting significant human risk within 15 days
f.statement: The sponsor or approval holder shall inform DRAP in a written investigational medicinal product safety report of any finding from tests in laboratory animals that suggests a significant risk for human subjects, including mutagenicity, teratogenicity or carcinogenicity, as soon as possible and not later than fifteen days after initial receipt of the information.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)(b)

rows.deadline: As soon as possible, not later than 15 days after initial receipt
rows.quote: finding from tests in laboratory animals that suggests a significant risk for human subjects including reports of mutagenicity, teratogenicity, or carcinogenicity. The reports shall be made as soon as possible and in not later than fifteen days after the initial receipt of the information.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)(b)
rows.review_note: Review: calendar days assumed. Double-check: confirmed.

deadline_rule.applies_to: Laboratory animal findings suggesting significant risk for humans

f.title: Identify IMP safety reports clearly; narrative format allowed; provide additional data on request
f.statement: Each written report may be submitted to DRAP in a narrative format and shall bear prominent identification of its contents, i.e. "investigational medicinal product safety report". If DRAP determines that additional data are needed, the sponsor or approval holder may be required to submit further data.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)

rows.quote: Each written report may be submitted to DRAP in a narrative format and shall bear prominent identification of its contents, i.e., “investigational medicinal product safety report." If DRAP determines that additional data are needed, the sponsor or approval holder, may require further data to be submitted.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (2)
rows.review_note: Review: narrative format is permitted; labelling is mandatory. Source "may require further data" read as DRAP may require. Double-check: headline level Mandatory (labelling).

f.title: Report all serious adverse events immediately to DRAP
f.statement: All serious adverse events should be reported immediately to DRAP.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (3)

rows.quote: (3) All serious adverse events should be reported immediately to the DRAP.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (3)
rows.review_note: Review: should = Recommended although rule 8(5) states a "shall" for adverse reactions. Double-check: confirmed.

f.title: Cross-reference and analyse previous similar reports in each IMP safety update report
f.statement: In each written investigational medicinal product safety update report, the sponsor shall identify all safety reports previously filed concerning a similar adverse experience and analyse the significance of the adverse experience in the light of the previous similar reports.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (4)

rows.quote: (4) In each written investigational medicinal product safety update report, the sponsor shall identify all safety reports previously filed with the investigational medicinal product concerning a similar adverse experience, and shall analyze the significance of the adverse experience in light of the previous, similar reports.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (4)

f.title: Use a different safety report format or frequency only as requested or agreed by the CSC
f.statement: The CSC may request a sponsor to submit the IMP safety update report in a different format or at a different frequency; the sponsor may propose and adopt a different reporting format or frequency only if the change is agreed in advance by the CSC.
f.clause: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (5)

rows.quote: (5) CSC may request a sponsor to submit investigational medicinal product safety update report in a format or at a frequency different than that required under this paragraph. The sponsor may also propose and adopt a different reporting format or frequency if the change is agreed to in advance by the CSC which is responsible for review of the Investigational Product.
rows.location: Rule 12 Review and report of safety information, (5)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: may = Permitted.

f.title: Maintain a verifiable record of trial subjects to prevent duplicate enrolment
f.statement: A verifiable record of clinical trial participants shall be maintained to stop duplicate enrolment and to improve patient safety and preserve data integrity; subject identification is closed information submitted directly by the investigator to DRAP.

rows.quote: A verifiable record of the clinical trial participants or subjects be maintained to stop duplicate enrolment and also to improve both patient safety and preserve data integrity of clinical trials. The subject identification shall be a closed information from the investigator, directly submitted to the DRAP.

dates.title: Pakistan Bio-study Rules, 2017 (S.R.O. 697(I)/2018): come into force
dates.scope: Contract research organisations, clinical research laboratories, BA/BE study centres and organisations involved in clinical trials of therapeutic goods and BA/BE studies on human subjects
dates.location: Notification header; rule 1(3) Short title and commencement
dates.timing_note: Rule 1(3): "They shall come into force at once." The notification S.R.O. 697 (I)/2018 is dated 5 June 2018; in-force date taken as the notification date (Gazette publication date not stated separately).
